answer:
solution.py was executed end-to-end and all required artifacts are written and verified. Summary below.

## Critical numerical finding (changed the work)
numpy's default SVD (LAPACK dgesdd) returns an INCONSISTENT factorization for this exact matrix: U and V are orthogonal, but ||Uᵀ K V − diag(σ)|| ≈ 2.8 (should be ~1e-15). This was caught by adding a factorization consistency check; all analysis now uses scipy's `gesvd` driver, verified to 9.1e-15. (The spectral data happened to be numerically similar under both, but the check is now permanent in solution.py.) Also, my first CGLS draft incorrectly ran CG on the nonsymmetric system Kx=y (residual diverged to ~10³); it was replaced with the proper Lanczos CGLS (s = Kᵀr), which behaves textbook-perfectly.

## Final diagnostics (diagnosis_report.md, picard_data.csv)
- K: 222×222 float64, dense, mixed signs, no Toeplitz/banded/symmetric structure. Singular values decay geometrically σᵢ ≈ 0.857^(i−1) (log10 slope −0.067/index), κ ≈ 6e14 — severely ill-posed.
- noise_estimate: 0.029056 (rms of spectral tail (Uᵀy)ᵢ, i ≥ 60; 1.4826·MAD gives 0.0262), relative ≈ 1.5%.
- effective_rank: 26 (smallest TSVD truncation with ||r|| ≤ τ·σ̂·√(n−t), τ=1; residual floor reached exactly at t=26: 0.4053 vs 0.4068).
- dpc_judgment: does_not_hold — Picard ratios |bᵢ|/σᵢ are O(1) (all < 10) up to i ≈ 40, then grow unboundedly (to ~1e13); plateau of |bᵢ| at ≈ 0.029 is the noise floor.
- Noise is white: tail skew −0.41, excess kurtosis 0.38, KS p = 0.31, runs test z = −1.1, y autocorrelations |r| ≤ 0.09. Whitening code path present but not activated (documented in the report).

## Per-method results (all parameters data-driven)
| Method | reg_param | fit ‖Kx−y‖ (floor σ̂√n = 0.4329) | ‖x‖ | stability (nearby params) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| method_a / tikhonov | λ = 0.0202 (GCV primary) | 0.4052 | 5.53 | 0.465 mean rel. change at λ/2, 2λ |
| method_b / tsvd | k = 26 (discrepancy) | 0.4053 | 6.80 | 0.494 mean rel. change over k±3 |
| method_c / cgls | 10 iterations (discrepancy stop) | 0.4319 | 3.94 | threshold-driven (scored least predictable) |
- Tikhonov cross-checks: discrepancy λ = 0.0612 (residual 0.4328, exactly at floor) — consistent with GCV; L-curve corner λ = 1.02 (residual 1.25 ≈ 3× floor) — MATERIAL DISAGREEMENT, explicitly flagged in the report and lcurve_data.csv: the log-log L-curve is nearly straight (max Menger curvature 9.2e-3, no pronounced corner — a known L-curve failure mode for white-noise discrete ill-posed problems), so the corner value was not used and GCV selected.
- TSVD: GCV independently gives k = 26 — exact agreement with the discrepancy principle.
- CGLS: residual decreases monotonically (0.863 → 0.432 by iter 10) and first crosses the noise floor at iteration 10; iteration-wise L-curve corner (iter 3) noted as cross-check.

## Comparison & recommendation (comparison_report.md, recommended_solution.csv)
- Cross-method relative differences: Tik–TSVD 0.40, Tik–CGLS 0.76, TSVD–CGLS 1.17. Crucially, a spectral decomposition of the differences shows 95–99% of the method disagreement lies in components i = 20–40 (the noise-dominated transition band); the leading trustworthy components agree (only 11–29% of the difference lies in i < 20).
- Recommended solution: Tikhonov (method_a) with λ = 0.0202 — residual within the noise floor, GCV corroborated by the discrepancy principle, smoothest filter (gradually damps the noisy transition band instead of passing hard-cutoff components with |bᵢ|/σᵢ ≈ 2–4, or partially fitting them as CGLS does), and lowest parameter sensitivity. recommended_solution.csv is byte-identical to method_a/tikhonov x_reg.csv.

## Artifacts (all verified non-empty, exact contract paths)
results/diagnosis/picard_data.csv (223 lines, 3-column header), results/diagnosis/diagnosis_report.md (structured fields noise_estimate / effective_rank / dpc_judgment), results/solution/{tikhonov,tsvd,cgls,method_a,method_b,method_c}/x_reg.csv + reg_param.txt (tikhonov & method_a also lcurve_data.csv, 701 lines), results/comparison/comparison_report.md, results/comparison/recommended_solution.csv, solution.py. Duplicated directory sets verified identical (filecmp).

## Limitations
- No ground truth available; the recommendation rests on internal evidence (noise floor fit, dual-criterion agreement, stability, smooth-filter argument).
- σ̂ assumes the spectral tail (i ≥ 60) is pure noise; if x had genuine energy there, σ̂ is biased upward and k_eff with it.
- The L-curve/GCV disagreement for Tikhonov is resolved in favor of GCV with explicit flagging; the effective-rank boundary (23–40 depending on criterion) remains inherently fuzzy.
